// @provenance rule: rule_class
export class Token {}

// @provenance rule: rule_default_function
export default function pays(hours) {
  return hours > 38;
}

// @provenance rule: rule_generator
export function* shifts() {
  yield 1;
}

// @provenance verification: examples
// @provenance rule: rule_test_callback
test("hours above 38", function overtimeExamples() {
  expect(pays(39)).toBe(true);
});

// @provenance verification: examples
// @provenance rule: rule_arrow_test
test("hours above 38", () => {
  expect(pays(39)).toBe(true);
});

// @provenance rule: rule_anonymous_default
export default function () {}

export function namedAfter() {}

export class Clock {
  // @provenance rule: rule_generator_method
  *hours() {
    let total = 0;
    return total;
  }
}

// @provenance rule: rule_let
let first, second;

// @provenance rule: rule_var
var counter = 0;
